name: 26112-longdecode-125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One card, one in-process engine.
architecture: OPTForCausalLM dense decoder, 125M: 12 layers, 12 heads, hidden 768, ffn 3072, vocab 50272, float16, learned absolute positions with max_position_embeddings 2048. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 1024 streams, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, `request_format: plain`, fixed by construction: 128 prompt tokens and exactly 1408 output tokens (min=max on both, `ignore_eos`), every prompt distinct. `request_format: plain` is required rather than cosmetic -- this checkpoint's tokenizer_config.json carries no chat template, so the default chat path has none to apply.
purpose: A long-form story generator for 1024 concurrent writers, short prompts and lengthy completions from a small model on one GPU.
launch:
model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# pinned, not left to the engine: unset, these resolve far below 1024 and clamp the operating point
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

disable-log-stats: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
